title: Gwinnett couple warn others after losing $800K in cryptocurrency scam

reading.body:
This incident shows a failure in verification at the point where an investment decision is made. A scammer used an AI-generated fake website to display false account balances and transaction history to a victim, creating the appearance of legitimate returns on cryptocurrency trades. The victim relied on what appeared on his screen without independent verification of the account or platform.

What would have caught this failure is a manual check: contacting the actual trading platform through official channels to verify the account existed and held the claimed funds. The scammer's initial contact and relationship-building through messaging is a social engineering tactic, but the decisive mechanism of the fraud was the synthetic visual evidence presented by the fake website.

It is not established how the AI-generated website was created, what specific generative tools were used, or whether the scammer trained a model or used an existing service.

reports.title: Georgia couple loses $800K in sophisticated cryptocurrency scam
Gwinnett couple warn others after losing $800K in cryptocurrency scam

summary:
A retired Georgia couple lost nearly $800,000 in a sophisticated cryptocurrency scam that started with a WhatsApp message from a stranger. The scammer encouraged Jerry Dunaway to invest in cryptocurrency through a mobile trading app, gradually building trust by allowing him to make small trades and withdraw modest returns. After weeks of successful transactions, Jerry attempted a larger withdrawal and discovered he could not access his funds. Police determined that while the trading app was legitimate, scammers had created an AI-generated fake website that displayed false investment information on his screen.

The couple, Jerry and Mindy Dunaway, are now warning others about the tactics used by sophisticated scammers who prey on unsuspecting victims. They have lost their entire life savings and are facing significant financial hardship. Though working with Gwinnett County police, investigators indicated that victims in these cases rarely recover their stolen money. The couple's children have launched a GoFundMe campaign to help their parents with daily living expenses as they attempt to rebuild their lives.
